{{Otheruses|Life's Memories}}
{{Quote|What begins, ends.<br />What is born, dies.<br />All that is made can be un-made.<br />Dark has no meaning without light,<br />And for all living things<br />there is the final<br />silence.|"''Life's Memories''" by Soshu Londahl|<ref name="Life's Memories">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030703memories|text=Life's Memories}}</ref>}}
'''''Life's Memories''''' was an [[Ithorese/Legends|Ithorese]] [[Poet/Legends|poem]] written by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Soshu Londahl]]. It was published in the anthology "''[[Lyrical Metaphysics: Ode on an Odon]]''" by [[Coruscani Publishing]] and was quoted by [[San Herrera]] and [[Nia Reston]] in their paper also named "[[Life's Memories (Herrera and Reston)|''Life's Memories'']]."
